description: What an options screen, chosen keys, save slots, a HUD with pictures, menus in a grid that scroll and touch controls say (PLAN_GAMES_3.md, Phase 4)

input.natural_language: A title with an Options button: how loud the music and the sounds are, the full screen, kept for the next time

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="options" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <qg:sound name="song" src="assets/kenney/audio/win.ogg" loop="true" bus="music" />
  <qg:sound name="jump" src="assets/kenney/audio/jump.ogg" bus="effects" />
  <qg:scene name="title" width="320" height="240">
    <qg:menu position="center" size="14">
      <qg:button label="Play"><qg:goto-scene name="level" /></qg:button>
      <qg:button label="Options"><qg:goto-scene name="options" /></qg:button>
    </qg:menu>
  </qg:scene>
  <!-- left and right change a slider; the volumes and the full screen are kept between runs -->
  <qg:scene name="options" width="320" height="240">
    <qg:menu position="center" size="14">
      <qg:slider label="Music" bus="music" />
      <qg:slider label="Sounds" bus="effects" step="20" />
      <qg:button label="{'Full screen: ' + ('on' if fullscreen() else 'off')}"><qg:fullscreen /></qg:button>
      <qg:button label="Back"><qg:goto-scene name="title" /></qg:button>
    </qg:menu>
  </qg:scene>
  <qg:scene name="level" width="320" height="240">
    <qg:music sound="song" />
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="platformer" sheet="people" frame="0" x="40" y="40" hitbox="14x20" jump-sound="jump" />
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

input.natural_language: A screen where each player picks the keys for jumping and firing; the next key pressed becomes the action's, and the choice is kept

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="keys" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <qg:input action="fire" keys="J" />
  <qg:input action="jump" keys="Up" player="2" />
  <qg:input action="fire" keys="Period" player="2" />
  <qg:scene name="keys" width="320" height="240">
    <!-- two columns: player 1's keys on the left, player 2's on the right -->
    <qg:menu position="center" size="12" columns="2">
      <qg:rebind label="P1 jump" action="jump" />
      <qg:rebind label="P2 jump" action="jump" player="2" />
      <qg:rebind label="P1 fire" action="fire" />
      <qg:rebind label="P2 fire" action="fire" player="2" />
    </qg:menu>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

input.natural_language: A title with three saved games: each goes on where it was left, or starts anew in its slot; each level entered saves it

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="slots" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <q:set name="coins" value="0" type="number" />
  <q:function name="slot_label" params="n">
    <q:return value="{'Game ' + str(n) + (': go on' if has_save(n) else ': new')}" />
  </q:function>
  <q:function name="play" params="n">
    <q:if condition="{has_save(n)}">
      <qg:continue slot="{n}" />
      <q:else>
        <q:set name="coins" value="0" />
        <qg:save slot="{n}" scene="level-1" />
        <qg:goto-scene name="level-1" />
      </q:else>
    </q:if>
  </q:function>
  <qg:scene name="title" width="320" height="240">
    <qg:menu position="center">
      <qg:button label="{slot_label(1)}"><q:call function="play" args="1" /></qg:button>
      <qg:button label="{slot_label(2)}"><q:call function="play" args="2" /></qg:button>
      <qg:button label="{slot_label(3)}"><q:call function="play" args="3" /></qg:button>
    </qg:menu>
  </qg:scene>
  <qg:scene name="level-1" width="320" height="240" save="true">
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="topdown" sheet="people" frame="0" x="40" y="40" hitbox="14x14" />
    <qg:exit name="east" x="316" y="0" width="8" height="240" to="level-2" at="west" />
  </qg:scene>
  <qg:scene name="level-2" width="320" height="240" save="true">
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="topdown" sheet="people" frame="0" x="40" y="40" hitbox="14x14" />
    <qg:exit name="west" x="-4" y="0" width="8" height="240" to="level-1" at="east" />
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

input.natural_language: Hearts drawn as a heart and a number in the top left, the coins in the bottom right in gold, and a warning that shows only on the last heart

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="hud" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <q:set name="hearts" value="3" type="number" />
  <q:set name="coins" value="0" type="number" />
  <qg:scene name="room" width="320" height="240">
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="topdown" sheet="people" frame="0" x="160" y="120" hitbox="14x14" />
    <qg:hud position="top-left">
      <qg:icon sheet="tiles" frame="44" />
      <qg:counter bind="hearts" label="x" color="#ff6060" />
    </qg:hud>
    <qg:hud position="bottom-right">
      <qg:icon sheet="tiles" frame="{151 if coins > 0 else 152}" />
      <qg:counter bind="coins" label="COINS" color="#ffd040" />
    </qg:hud>
    <qg:hud position="top-center" if="{hearts == 1}"><qg:text value="{'LAST HEART'}" color="#ff2020" /></qg:hud>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

input.natural_language: A platformer that shows a stick and a jump button on a touch screen; they press the same actions as the keys
Escape pauses the game; the pause menu has the effects' volume, a button that mutes the music, and resume

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="mute" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <qg:sound name="song" src="assets/kenney/audio/win.ogg" loop="true" bus="music" />
  <qg:sound name="hit" src="assets/kenney/audio/stomp.ogg" bus="effects" />
  <qg:scene name="level" width="320" height="240">
    <qg:music sound="song" />
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="topdown" sheet="people" frame="0" x="160" y="120" hitbox="14x14" />
    <qg:on-input action="cancel">
      <q:if condition="{paused()}"><qg:resume /><q:else><qg:pause /></q:else></q:if>
    </qg:on-input>
    <qg:menu if="{paused()}" size="14">
      <qg:button label="Resume"><qg:resume /></qg:button>
      <qg:slider label="Sounds" bus="effects" />
      <qg:button label="{'Music: ' + ('off' if volume('music') == 0 else 'on')}">
        <qg:volume bus="music" value="{100 if volume('music') == 0 else 0}" />
      </qg:button>
    </qg:menu>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>
